_about: Public-domain Alfred Williams Momerie (1848-1900), Anglican priest, professor of logic at King's College London and preacher at the Foundling Hospital, for the Word Hoard: The Origin of Evil (1879), The Basis of Religion (1886), Belief in God (1886), Defects of Modern Christianity (1888), Agnosticism (1889), Personality, the Beginning and End of Metaphysics (1889), Inspiration (1889), Church and Creed (1890), Preaching and Hearing (1890), The Religion of the Future (1893) and Immortality (1901). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 79 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
